summary: Reusable how-tos the assistant proposes after solving a task. Nothing is used until you approve it; search returns approved skills only.

tools.name: tool_skill_search
tools.purpose: Search your approved skills; an empty query lists the newest

tools.name: tool_skill_mark
tools.purpose: Record whether a followed skill worked (MCP-only: assistant feedback)

tools.name: tool_skill_propose
tools.purpose: Propose a skill for your approval (MCP-only: written by the assistant)

params.name: query
params.description: Words describing the task; empty lists the newest approved skills.

workflow.explanation: Look for an approved skill before a multi-step task.
Record whether the followed skill solved the task.
After solving a new multi-step task, propose a skill.
You approve or retire proposed skills; a proposal is never used before that.
